full_judgment:
(i) That from the copy of her own application dated 15-10-1975 addressed to the Secretary, Ministry of Works clearly indicates that she is a bonafide refugee from India in the year 1950 and the same is contrary to her submission that she was born at Goalpara, Dhaka. 

 30. The petitioner in her application dated 15-10-75, Annexure-C-1, stated that she came from India in the year 1950. In the application under section 7 of the Ordinance, her date of birth had been shown on 1-1-1956 at Goal Nagar under PS Kotwali. In the writ petition, it is stated that she was born in the year 1954 at Goal Nagar. The Court of Settlement duly considered these aspects of the matter. It appears, further from the judgment of the Court of Settlement that the petitioner filed in the Court a certificate from a Ward Commissioner showing her nationality in Bangladesh. The said certificate has not been annexed in the writ petition. The Court of Settlement held that the Certificate dated 13-7-86 said to have been issued by the Chairman, Ward No. 34, Dhaka Municipal Corporation to the effect that she is a permanent resident of Malitola and that she is a citizen of Bangladesh has not been proved in accordance with law. The argument addressed before us on behalf of the petitioner that the Court of Settlement did not at all consider any document produced before it appears to have no substance.
